summary: PS International Group Ltd., a Hong Kong-based freight cargo arrangement company, filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 18, 2026, failed to achieve the required quorum of at least one-half of outstanding voting shares. As a result, no business was transacted and the Board resolved not to adjourn the meeting, concluding it without action. The Board may consider convening a future EGM and will issue formal notice if so. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation transaction or event; the registrant is the filer reporting a failed shareholder meeting quorum, with no deal terms or strategic action announced.
